current.note: R5.0a: gate is now class-breakdown aware and can run with either OCR engine (--ocr-engine legacy|lattice). R5.0d (2026-09-14) grew the OCR arm of the ground truth from 12 to 112 records (Fragmentation 12, GlyphConfusion 36, GarbageInsertion 33, SpuriousSpace 1, Mixed 30 - MissingSpace and a fuller SpuriousSpace could not be populated from the D70-mandated candidate pool, see the R5.0d closing report) plus 28 new Hyphenation records, and re-measured both engines against the larger, motor-touched ground truth (288 knownErrors total: 176 Hyphenation + 112 OCR-arm). Aggregate thresholds and classRecallThresholds are UNCHANGED (D77 - this fazda yalnizca yukari hareket edebilir): both engines now FAIL the gate against the larger ground truth (this is the expected outcome per plan risk #12/kural 4.5 - the old 92.5%/100% thresholds were fit to a ground truth that barely touched the OCR engines at all, D64). The measured (failing) values below are the target for R5.4b's threshold-and-search-space sweep, not a new threshold.

legacy.note: R5.0d re-measurement (was R4.0c's 12-record measurement: CorrectlyFixed=148, WronglyFixed=0, Deferred=12). Against the 288-record schemaVersion-3 ground truth, legacy now shows real wrong-corrections for the first time: odun-kesmek-glyph-0030 ('olın'->'olan', independently verified correct answer is 'John' - EvidenceOnly confidence, the lowest tier legacy has), odun-kesmek-mixed-0022 ('kol-1 ıı kta', legacy only fixes the inner 'ıı'->'ı' sub-span and leaves the surrounding hyphen/digit, so the occurrence reads 'kol-1 ı kta' - not 'koltukta'; this is the one D65 already flagged as legacy's own defect fixed correctly only by lattice's sibling occurrence), and odun-kesmek-auto-0174 ('zencileri-11in', hyphenation removes the dash but the OCR stage leaves the '11' digits untouched, producing 'zencileri11in'). Gate FAILS: recall 89.93% < 92.5%, ClassRecall:Hyphenation 96.59% < 100%. Expected per plan risk #12 - the ground truth now actually measures the OCR engines instead of measuring hyphenation alone (D64).

lattice.note: R5.0d re-measurement (was R5.0a's 12-record measurement: CorrectlyFixed=149, WronglyFixed=1, Deferred=10, recall 93.12%, gate PASS). Against the 288-record ground truth the gate now FAILS just as sharply as it passed before: recall 58.33% < 92.5%, ClassRecall:Hyphenation 88.64% < 100% - precision stays just above the 98% floor (98.25%) but is now measured on 168 correct fixes instead of 1. This is the headline confirmation of D68/D69's premise: the old 12-record gate never actually exercised the lattice engine's recall gap (D64); it does now. The KAYIP-sourced ground truth (119 records where legacy fixes and lattice does not) explains almost all of the recall drop. This measured recall (58.33%) is R5.4b's numeric starting point, not a new threshold (kural 4.5/D77 - thresholds only move up).
